responsibility: This header declares the data structures and inline predicates for GCC’s SESE-region abstraction used by region-based GIMPLE analyses such as Graphite. It defines the lightweight sese_l edge-pair descriptor, the richer sese_info_t bookkeeping object with liveout bitmaps, parameter vectors, rename maps, and basic-block lists, plus ifsese support for guard-shaped regions. It also provides inline region/loop membership tests, SESE loop-depth helpers, gimple_poly_bb region metadata declarations, and the public APIs implemented in sese.cc for liveout construction, PHI insertion, scalar-evolution queries, invariance checks, and conditional wrapping of regions.
same_name_distinction: This .h file defines the SESE and ifsese data structures plus inline region, loop, and bookkeeping predicates, while gcc/sese.cc provides the heavier CFG/SSA transformation, liveout construction, scalar-evolution, and printing implementations that operate on those abstractions.
